lines.text: 옛날 옛날, 방앗간에 늙은 당나귀가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, an old donkey lived at a mill.
Give the donkey a tap!
Tap the donkey!

lines.text: 당나귀는 오랫동안 무거운 곡식 자루를 날랐어요. 이제는 힘이 없어요.
lines.en: The donkey had carried heavy sacks of grain for a very long time. Now the donkey was too tired.
segs: The donkey had carried heavy sacks of grain for a very long time. Now the donkey was too tired.

lines.text: 주인: "이제 일을 못 하겠구나. 너를 내보내야겠다."
lines.en: Miller: "You can't work anymore. I have to send you away."
segs: You can't work anymore. I have to send you away.
lines.prev: The donkey had carried heavy sacks of grain for a very long time. Now the donkey was too tired.

lines.text: 당나귀: "괜찮아! 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 될 거야!"
lines.en: Donkey: "That's okay! I'll go to Bremen and become a musician!"
segs: That's okay! I'll go to Bremen and become a musician!
lines.prev: Miller: "You can't work anymore. I have to send you away."

lines.en: The donkey walked along the road, and a bush began to wiggle and wobble.
segs: The donkey walked along the road, and a bush began to wiggle and wobble.

lines.en: Woof, woof, from behind the bush! Who could it be?
segs: Woof, woof, from behind the bush! Who could it be?

lines.text: 멍멍 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
lines.en: Who goes woof, woof? Listen again.

lines.text: 야옹 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
lines.en: Who goes meow? Listen again.

lines.text: 꼬끼오 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
lines.en: Who goes cock-a-doodle-doo? Listen again.
It's the donkey! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's the donkey! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: It's the dog! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's the dog! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: It's the cat! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's the cat! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: It's the rooster! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's the rooster! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: The dog went huff, huff, with a long tongue sticking out.
Dog: "I got too old to hunt, so I was sent away."
segs: I got too old to hunt, so I was sent away.
lines.prev: The dog went huff, huff, with a long tongue sticking out.

lines.text: 당나귀: "그럼 우리 같이 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 되자!"
lines.en: Donkey: "Then come with us! Let's go to Bremen and be musicians together!"
segs: Then come with us! Let's go to Bremen and be musicians together!
lines.prev: Dog: "I got too old to hunt, so I was sent away."

lines.en: A meow from up on the wall! Who could it be?
segs: A meow from up on the wall! Who could it be?

lines.text: 수염이 축 처진 고양이예요. "쥐를 못 잡는다고 내보내졌어."
lines.en: This cat's whiskers are drooping. "I can't catch mice anymore, so I was sent away."
segs: I can't catch mice anymore, so I was sent away.

lines.en: Dog: "Come with us! Let's sing in Bremen!"
segs: Come with us! Let's sing in Bremen!
lines.prev: This cat's whiskers are drooping. "I can't catch mice anymore, so I was sent away."

lines.en: A cock-a-doodle-doo from up on the roof! Who could it be?
segs: A cock-a-doodle-doo from up on the roof! Who could it be?

lines.en: Rooster: "They say I'm not needed anymore. Cock-a-doodle-doo..."
segs: They say I'm not needed anymore. Cock-a-doodle-doo...
lines.prev: A cock-a-doodle-doo from up on the roof! Who could it be?

lines.text: 당나귀: "우리랑 음악대 하자! 네 목소리 최고야!"
lines.en: Donkey: "Join our band! Your voice is the best!"
segs: Join our band! Your voice is the best!
lines.prev: Rooster: "They say I'm not needed anymore. Cock-a-doodle-doo..."

lines.text: 당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 닭. 네 친구가 모였어요!
lines.en: Donkey, dog, cat, and rooster. Four friends together at last!
segs: Donkey, dog, cat, and rooster. Four friends together at last!

lines.text: 길가 풀밭에서 노래 연습을 해요. 당나귀가 먼저 들려줄게요. 잘 듣고 똑같이 톡톡!
lines.en: Let's practice singing on the grassy roadside. The donkey will go first. Listen well, then tap just the same!
segs: Let's practice singing on the grassy roadside. The donkey will go first. Listen well, then tap just the same!

lines.text: 이번엔 세 개! 잘 들어 봐요.
lines.en: This time there are three! Listen carefully.
segs: This time there are three! Listen carefully.

lines.en: This is the last song. Listen carefully.
segs: This is the last song. Listen carefully.

lines.en: Now tap just the same!

lines.text: 하하, 새 노래가 됐네! 한 번 더!
lines.en: Ha ha, that made a brand-new song! Try once more!
segs: Ha ha, that made a brand-new song! Try once more!

lines.en: Whose sound came first?
Whose sound came next?
Woof, meow! Well done!
Hee-haw, woof, cock-a-doodle-doo! What a wonderful song!
segs: Hee-haw, woof, cock-a-doodle-doo! What a wonderful song!

lines.en: Meow, cock-a-doodle-doo, hee-haw! The best band ever!
segs: Meow, cock-a-doodle-doo, hee-haw! The best band ever!

lines.text: 해가 지고 캄캄한 숲이 되었어요. 부엉이가 부엉부엉.
lines.en: The sun went down, and the forest grew dark. The owl went hoo, hoo.
segs: The sun went down, and the forest grew dark. The owl went hoo, hoo.

lines.text: 숲을 지나가요. 옆으로 쓱 밀어 줘요!
lines.en: Let's pass through the forest. Swipe sideways!
segs: Let's pass through the forest. Swipe sideways!

lines.en: Swipe sideways! Let's pass through the forest.
segs: Swipe sideways! Let's pass through the forest.

lines.en: The rooster flapped up to the top of a tree.
Rooster: "I see a light over there! There's a house!"
segs: I see a light over there! There's a house!
lines.prev: The rooster flapped up to the top of a tree.

lines.text: 불빛이 새어 나오는 창문이에요. 그런데 너무 높아서 아무도 안 닿아요.
lines.en: Light is shining out of a window. But it's so high that no one can reach it.

lines.text: 서로 등에 올라서 탑을 쌓아요! 크고 무거운 친구가 맨 아래예요.
lines.en: Let's climb onto each other's backs and build a tower! The biggest, heaviest friend goes at the bottom.
Who will stand at the bottom?
segs: Who will stand at the bottom?

lines.en: Who goes at the very top?
segs: Who goes at the very top?

lines.en: Who will climb onto the donkey's back?
segs: Who will climb onto the donkey's back?

lines.en: Who will climb onto the dog's back?
segs: Who will climb onto the dog's back?

lines.en: Dog: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
segs: Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~
lines.prev: The donkey climbed up and squashed the small friend flat!

lines.en: Cat: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
segs: Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~
lines.prev: The donkey climbed up and squashed the small friend flat!

lines.en: Rooster: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
segs: Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~
lines.prev: The donkey climbed up and squashed the small friend flat!

lines.text: 흔들흔들! 더 크고 무거운 친구가 먼저예요.
lines.en: Wobble, wobble! The bigger, heavier friend goes first.
The donkey goes at the bottom! So strong.
segs: The donkey goes at the bottom! So strong.

lines.text: 당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 닭! 닭이 창문에 닿았어요!
lines.en: Donkey, dog, cat, rooster! The rooster reached the window!
segs: Donkey, dog, cat, rooster! The rooster reached the window!

lines.text: 창문 안을 들여다보니, 도둑 셋이 금화를 세며 맛있는 걸 먹고 있어요.
lines.en: Peeking through the window, three robbers are counting gold coins and eating tasty food.
segs: Peeking through the window, three robbers are counting gold coins and eating tasty food.

lines.en: Robber: "Look at all this gold! Ha ha ha!"
segs: Look at all this gold! Ha ha ha!
lines.prev: Peeking through the window, three robbers are counting gold coins and eating tasty food.

lines.en: Rooster: "Let's play our music nice and loud!"
segs: Let's play our music nice and loud!
lines.prev: Robber: "Look at all this gold! Ha ha ha!"

lines.text: 도둑을 놀라게 할 노래예요. 먼저 들어 봐요!
lines.en: This song will scare the robbers. Listen first!
segs: This song will scare the robbers. Listen first!

lines.en: This time, tap the friend who is singing!
segs: This time, tap the friend who is singing!

lines.text: 다 같이 목청껏! 톡톡톡 눌러서 노래해요!
lines.en: All together, as loud as you can! Tap, tap, tap to sing!
segs: All together, as loud as you can! Tap, tap, tap to sing!

lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the tower! Sing even louder!
segs: Tap, tap, tap the tower! Sing even louder!

lines.en: The robbers yelled, "A monster!" and scampered off into the forest.
segs: and scampered off into the forest.

lines.text: 네 친구는 남은 음식을 냠냠 먹고, 불을 끄고 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: The four friends munched the leftover food, put out the light, and fell fast asleep.
segs: The four friends munched the leftover food, put out the light, and fell fast asleep.

lines.text: 한밤중, 도둑 하나가 살금살금 돌아왔어요. 쉿!
lines.en: In the middle of the night, one robber tiptoed back. Shh!
segs: In the middle of the night, one robber tiptoed back. Shh!

lines.text: 아궁이 안에서 뭔가 반짝! 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Something is sparkling in the fireplace! Give it a tap.
segs: Something is sparkling in the fireplace! Give it a tap.

lines.en: Robber: "Ouch, that stings! I thought it was a glowing ember!"
segs: Ouch, that stings! I thought it was a glowing ember!
lines.prev: Something is sparkling in the fireplace! Give it a tap.

lines.text: 문 앞에 또 반짝! 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Another sparkle by the door! Give it a tap.
segs: Another sparkle by the door! Give it a tap.

lines.en: Robber: "Ow! Something poked my leg!"
lines.prev: Another sparkle by the door! Give it a tap.

lines.en: There's a sparkle in the pile of straw, too! Give it a tap.
segs: There's a sparkle in the pile of straw, too! Give it a tap.

lines.en: Robber: "Yikes! Something kicked me, boom!"
lines.prev: There's a sparkle in the pile of straw, too! Give it a tap.

lines.text: 저 위 들보에서도 반짝! 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: And another sparkle up on the high beam! Give it a tap.
segs: And another sparkle up on the high beam! Give it a tap.

lines.en: Robber: "Help me~!"
lines.prev: And another sparkle up on the high beam! Give it a tap.

lines.text: 도둑: "그 집엔 귀신이 할퀴고, 누가 다리를 콕 찌르고, 거인이 쿵 차고, 지붕에선 재판관이 도둑 잡아라! 소리쳤어!"
lines.en: Robber: "In that house, a ghost scratched me, someone poked my leg, a giant kicked me, and up on the roof a judge shouted, 'Catch the thief!'"
segs: In that house, a ghost scratched me, someone poked my leg, a giant kicked me, and up on the roof a judge shouted, 'Catch the thief!'
lines.prev: A frightened robber ran back into the forest and told the boss all about it, making a big fuss and exaggerating.

lines.text: 사실은 고양이, 강아지, 당나귀, 닭이었는데 말이에요! 도둑들은 다시는 오지 않았어요.
lines.en: It was really a cat, a dog, a donkey, and a rooster! The robbers never came back.
segs: It was really a cat, a dog, a donkey, and a rooster! The robbers never came back.

lines.text: 아침이 밝았어요. 네 친구는 이 집이 참 좋았어요.
lines.en: Morning came. The four friends loved this house.
segs: Morning came. The four friends loved this house.

lines.en: "We never got to Bremen, but this is our home!"
segs: We never got to Bremen, but this is our home!
lines.prev: Morning came. The four friends loved this house.

lines.text: 기쁨의 노래를 연주해요! 먼저 들어 봐요.
lines.en: Let's play the song of joy! Listen first.
segs: Let's play the song of joy! Listen first.

lines.text: 이번에는 친구들을 톡톡 눌러서 같이 연주해요!
lines.en: This time, tap the friends and play together!
segs: This time, tap the friends and play together!

lines.en: Well done! Now play however you like!
segs: Well done! Now play however you like!

lines.en: Together, the Bremen Town Musicians were so happy.
segs: Together, the Bremen Town Musicians were so happy.

cut_monster: In the dark night, something like a monster came crashing in through the window!
The robbers are scared out of their wits and run away!
cut_ghost: It's true, I promise! A ghost and a giant and a judge!
A robber is trembling and exaggerating.

ui.나이 들어도, 작아도, 함께라면 해낼 수 있어요!: Old or small, together we can do it!
